description:
Recently wiped servers. Wipes detected across every online server in the window, newest first - the feed behind
servers.rustprofit.com/wipes. A wipe is detected when a server's `world_seed` or `world_size` changes between
two polls, or when the last-wipe time it advertises moves past our previous poll (for servers with A2S rules
disabled). Each entry has `detected_at`, the old and new seed/size, and the full server record. Expect
thousands of entries in the 24 hours after Rust's monthly forced wipe (first Thursday). Cached for five minutes.

hours.description: Look-back window in hours (1-168). The site's /wipes page shows 24.

name: get_recent_wipes
